field_text_formatted.value: 0.25.0 added a server cache for the JSON:API index and menus. It skips any request that carries credentials, but it only saw a token added by an Axios interceptor once the response came back. Until then, a signed-in visitor could get a response cached for anonymous visitors. 0.25.2 runs your request interceptors on a copy of each request before it checks the cache, so the cache turns off from the first request (#1018).
